summary_1line: Ravana sends the envoy Shuka to persuade Sugriva to abandon Rama, but Sugriva angrily rejects the message and threatens Ravana with destruction.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shuka the rakshasa messenger hovers in the sky above the sea while furious monkeys leap upward to strike him with their fists.
Rama stands calmly on the seashore and raises his hand to stop the monkeys from killing the captured envoy.
Sugriva, surrounded by a vast army of monkeys and bears near the ocean, angrily denounces Ravana's message.
